observations: Single photo shows one IBC (Intermediate Bulk Container) tank in a metal cage frame with a black screw cap on top.
A hand is touching the cage, giving some scale, but no ruler or tape measure is shown.
Background shows multiple other IBC tanks stacked on pallets, some with visibly rusted cages.
The tank's bottom outlet/valve area is not visible in this photo.
No visible label, manufacturer markings, or prior-content stickers on the tank body.
Watermark reads 'EMMALINK CONCEPT NIG', seller's business mark, not a proof of condition.

identity.kind: IBC tank (intermediate bulk container) for liquid storage

claims.claim: IBC tank for storage of water or any liquid
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a generic IBC tank shape; no way to confirm it is currently leak-free or food-safe for water from a photo alone.
No stress test, crack, or structural close-up shown; subjective claim with no supporting image.

risks.risk: Plastic tank body may have hairline cracks, UV embrittlement, or prior chemical residue affecting safety for water storage.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the tank walls (front, back, both sides) and an interior shot through the top cap opening.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a used tank of unknown/compromised integrity, not food-grade certified

risks.risk: Bottom valve/outlet could be missing, cracked, or non-functional — not shown in the photo.
risks.proof: Photo of the bottom valve/spout area.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming valve is absent or non-functional

risks.risk: Metal cage may be rusted or structurally weakened, as seen on other units stacked in the background.
risks.proof: Close-up of this specific tank's cage, especially joints and base rails.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a rusted/weakened cage

risks.risk: Unknown prior contents (could have held industrial chemicals rather than food-grade liquids).
risks.proof: Any UN/IBC code plate or label photo, or seller statement with supporting photo of markings.

risks.risk: Tank capacity (commonly 1000L but sizes vary) cannot be confirmed without markings or measurement.
risks.proof: Photo of capacity marking plate or a tape measure against the tank.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the smallest common capacity for this tank style

proof_requests: Clear photo of the bottom valve/outlet.
Photo of any capacity/UN code plate on the cage or tank.
Close-up photos of the tank body for cracks or discoloration.
Interior photo through the top cap opening.
Close-up of this specific unit's cage for rust/damage, not the background stock.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a used IBC tank, but unverified condition of valve, cage rust, and prior contents mean it must be priced at worst case as a used, unverified-safety tank until further photos are provided.
